meta.name: lark-contact
meta.description: 飞书 / Lark 通讯录:按姓名 / 邮箱解析成 open_id,或按 open_id 反查姓名 / 部门 / 邮箱 / 联系方式 / 个人状态 / 签名。当用户提到某人姓名要下一步发消息 / 排日程,或拿到 open_id 想查具体信息时使用。不负责部门树遍历、按部门列员工、组织架构图,这类需求走原生 OpenAPI。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按姓名或邮箱查飞书联系人信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要根据姓名或邮箱获取飞书联系人详情。
copy.tagline_en: Look up Lark contacts by name or email
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to get Lark contact details from names or emails.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据姓名或邮箱查到飞书同事的 open_id，也能用 open_id 反查姓名、部门、邮箱、联系方式、个人状态和签名。
howto.when: 当你提到某位同事的姓名，并想给他发消息或安排日程时触发；或者当你拿到一个 open_id，想查看对应人员的详细信息时触发。

say.note: Claude 会搜索张三并返回 open_id。

say.text: 用 open_id ou_xxx 查这个人的部门。
say.note: Claude 会反查该 open_id 对应的部门信息。

say.text: 看看李四的个人状态和签名。
say.note: Claude 会查询李四的个人状态和个性签名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can look up a colleague's open_id by name or email, and can also retrieve name, department, email, contact info, personal status, and signature from an open_id.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a colleague's name and want to send a message or schedule a meeting, or when you have an open_id and want to look up detailed information.

say_en.note: Claude will search for Zhang San and return the open_id.

say_en.text: Use open_id ou_xxx to find this person's department.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve the department info for that open_id.

say_en.text: Check Li Si's personal status and signature.
say_en.note: Claude will query Li Si's personal status and signature.
